opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to a miner URL and invites them to join through the speaker’s link, while the displayed site offers a wallet-connected BNB opportunity. It claims to have been paying 3% for over 400 days and presents controls to hire miners, compound returns, and pocket BNB. The speaker further predicts, “i'll be making three b and b per day,” making the opportunity a concrete daily-earnings proposition rather than a general discussion. Although he acknowledges possible loss and calls the funds risk capital, those cautions do not resolve the central offer of BNB returns through the miner and wallet connection.

citations.quote: i'll be making three b and b per day
Small risk capital guys, remember I'm not a financial advisor. I always put into this risk capital what you're willing to lose. You could make a lot, you could lose, but you never know guys.
